paragraphs: R. Ammihud. The introduction to Sefer Me’irat Einayim (Sema) lists the second generation after the destruction: R. Tarfon, R. Akiva, R. Elazar of Modi'in and R. Ammihud. End of quotation. I did not find his mention in the Shas.
